svg.title: RefArch_MDG1evo SW-Architecture V1.12.0
svg.desc: Export of the Static.picture worksheet DrawingML shapes from RefArch_MDG1evo_34010-RefArch_MDG1evo-34010-14.xlsx. Source geometry, group transforms, colors, opacity and labels retained. Bosch Sans is replaced with Arial-compatible Liberation Sans; original typeface names are retained as metadata. Preset geometry: ECMA-376 definitions distributed by Apache POI.
